# MCP stdio bridge

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/mcp-server)

Forward local JSON-RPC over stdio to the storefront HTTPS MCP gate.

**Scope:** Transport bridge; the remote gate owns tools, authentication and paused-write policies. It is not a Streamable HTTP server.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/mcp-server`.
